  Thanks for contributing to Kansei. Keep PRs focused; one logical change per PR.

  (see CONTRIBUTING.md, Scope).

## Summary

<!-- What does this change, and why? -->

## Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Chore / CI / deps

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes (in `src-tauri`, if Rust touched)
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes (if Rust touched)
- [ ] `cargo test` passes (if Rust touched)
- [ ] `CONTRACT.md` updated in the same commit if commands, events, persistence, layout or a feature's behaviour changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (for user-facing changes)
- [ ] README updated if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] No em dashes in new copy
